card.name: Maintenance dose just before the interval
card.fires_on: The unit word after a maintenance dose amount (mg, /kg, administered, injection), right where the dosing interval such as 'every 8 weeks' or 'once monthly' will follow. It appears in injectable biologic dosing regimens after an induction phase.

modes.label: mg after repeat dose
modes.description: The unit mg after a follow-on dose number, just before an every-N-weeks interval.

modes.label: Route or verb before schedule
modes.description: Words like administered or injection after a dose, before the schedule.
modes.example: followed by 6 mg (0.05 mL) by intravitreal<< injection>> once every 8 to 12

card.writes: It pushes toward time-span words like months and years and away from daily words, which fits a long-interval schedule.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a maintenance dose where the text says how many weeks or months apart the doses are, not daily.
